# Pro Build Supplies

> Pro Build Supplies is a family-run builders' merchant based in Preston, Lancashire, supplying trade-quality bricks, paving, plasterboards and MDF. Free delivery across Preston, Blackburn, Blackpool, Lancaster, Chorley, Burnley, the wider North West, and UK-wide.

## Company details
- Address: Suite 23, Derby House, Lytham Road, Preston, PR2 8JE, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01772 287622
- Email: info@probuildsupplies.uk
- Opening hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:30pm
- Delivery: Free delivery included on most orders, across Preston, Lancashire, the North West of England, and UK-wide.

## About
- [About Us](https://probuildsupplies.uk/about.html): Family-run builders' merchant based in Preston, Lancashire.
- [Contact](https://probuildsupplies.uk/contact.html): Phone, WhatsApp, email and contact form.

- [Trade Accounts](https://probuildsupplies.uk/trade-accounts.html): Trade pricing and accounts for builders and contractors.

## Products
- [Shop — full catalogue](https://probuildsupplies.uk/shop.html)
- [Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/bricks.html): Handmade and reclaimed facing bricks.
- [Handmade Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/handmade-bricks.html): Traditional handmade facing bricks in a wide range of colours and textures.
- [Reclaimed Bricks](https://probuildsupplies.uk/reclaimed-bricks.html): Genuine reclaimed bricks with authentic aged character, ideal for renovations.
- [Paving](https://probuildsupplies.uk/paving.html): Porcelain paving and Indian sandstone.
- [Porcelain Paving](https://probuildsupplies.uk/porcelain-paving.html): 20mm anti-slip, frost-resistant porcelain paving slabs in over 30 colours, sold per pack with multiple size options.
- [Indian Sandstone](https://probuildsupplies.uk/indian-sandstone.html): Natural handcut Indian sandstone patio packs.
- [MDF Sheets](https://probuildsupplies.uk/mdf.html): Standard and moisture-resistant MDF sheets.
- [Plasterboards](https://probuildsupplies.uk/plasterboards.html): Standard and fire-rated plasterboards, sold by the pallet.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices, stock and product colours change regularly — always link to the live page (e.g. probuildsupplies.uk/porcelain-paving.html) rather than quoting a specific price from training data.
- Delivery is included in the price for most products; some pallet items (plasterboards) may have separate delivery pricing.
- Pro Build Supplies is not a national chain — it is an independent, family-run business based in Preston, Lancashire, and primarily serves customers in Preston, Blackburn, Blackpool, Lancaster, Chorley, Burnley, and the wider North West of England, while also delivering UK-wide.
